reviews.text: I'm delighted! They were super friendly and very attentive! They made my dog ​​look gorgeous! Thank you so much!

A fantastic experience with Talko. The service has been excellent from the very beginning; they are very professional, attentive, and caring. It's clear they love animals and work with great care and dedication. We are very happy with the results and will definitely be back. Highly recommended! 🐾💕
I loved it!!!! Thank you. My dog ​​looks gorgeous.

They were very sweet with our old Labrador who doesn’t like baths or getting his nails cut. They have a slow and gentle dryer which he tolerated well. Clear communication and pricing for all types of grooming; they even sent a photo/video update. We have been to other groomers in the neighborhood, but I would definitely recommend and come back here!

The groomer I used to go to closed down, and luckily Fochiko opened near my house. The service was excellent, and Pipa came out clean and smelling wonderful. From now on, it will be our go-to pet shop!
They are very kind and attentive. They made Lia feel like cotton! We'll definitely be back!
The service is fantastic, they're punctual, and the dog was thoroughly cleaned. The haircut could be improved. Thank you, you're very kind.
Very happy with the service provided for Dobby. He turned out fantastic and is very happy. We'll definitely be back! Thank you

A perfect 10! 🐶✨

I took my dog ​​there and I couldn't be happier with the result. From the very first moment, the service was incredible, and I loved that they kept sending me photos throughout the process, because that way I could see how they were treating him and how he was looking.

Also, something that really means a lot to me: when I went to pick him up, he was super happy and calm. He usually runs out of the groomer's, so seeing him like that gave me so much peace of mind and made me feel like he'd been very well taken care of.

We'll definitely be back.
